issues.legal_issue: Dumpers and rockers suitable for use on public roads are motor vehicles liable to taxation when used or kept for use within the state.
material_facts: The appellants used dumpers and rockers in their mining operations within their leasehold areas.
The machines had rubber tyres, and materials before the Court showed that dumpers could be permitted to run on public roads, subject to speed limits.
The machines were not shown to be specially adapted for use only in factories or other enclosed premises.

The appellants challenged the tax demands on the ground that the machines were not adapted for use on roads; they did not challenge the validity or retrospectivity of the amending legislation in these appeals.
issues.conclusion: The dumpers and rockers were adapted or suitable for use on roads and were liable to taxation when used or kept for use on public roads; the appeals were dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 2(b) and 3(1) of the Orissa Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1975, a motor vehicle adapted for use on roads is taxable when used or kept for use within the state. Following Bolani Ores Ltd. v. State of Orissa, the word “adapted” means “suitable.” Rubber tyres and the ability to operate on public roads supported the conclusion that the machines were suitable for road use; their weight, limited permitted speeds, or use in mining areas did not make them unsuitable. The exclusion for a vehicle specially adapted for use only in a factory or other enclosed premises did not apply.

rule.if: motor_vehicle_tax_appeal and vehicle_has_rubber_tyres and vehicle_can_be_permitted_on_public_roads and not vehicle_adapted_only_for_enclosed_use and vehicle_used_or_kept_for_use_in_state

predicates.motor_vehicle_tax_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal challenging a demand for motor vehicle tax on a vehicle.
predicates.vehicle_has_rubber_tyres: The vehicle runs on rubber tyres rather than chain plates.
predicates.vehicle_can_be_permitted_on_public_roads: The vehicle is capable of being permitted to operate on public roads, even if subject to restrictions.
predicates.vehicle_adapted_only_for_enclosed_use: The vehicle is specially adapted for use only in a factory or another enclosed premises.
predicates.vehicle_used_or_kept_for_use_in_state: The vehicle is used or kept for use within the state imposing the tax.
predicates.vehicle_is_liable_to_motor_vehicle_tax: The vehicle is liable to motor vehicle taxation.

issues.definition: When a tax appeal concerns a vehicle used or kept for use within a state, and the vehicle has rubber tyres, can be permitted on public roads, and is not adapted only for enclosed use, the vehicle is liable to motor vehicle tax.
